up: List all approved drugs indicated for type 2 diabetes mellitus. An approved drug is defined as having max_phase = 4 in the molecule_dictionary. Retrieve the following columns: 1) molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), 2) pref_name (preferred name from molecule_dictionary), 3) canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), 4) mesh_heading (the specific indication from drug_indication), 5) efo_term (the indication term from drug_indication). The indication must be related to 'diabetes mellitus type 2'. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno to get the indication details. Join compound_structures on molregno to get the structure. Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading to contain 'diabetes' or 'diabetes mellitus'. Return all matching rows without limiting the number of results.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%diabetes%'

up: List all approved drugs indicated specifically for 'type 2 diabetes mellitus'. An approved drug is defined as having max_phase = 4 in the molecule_dictionary. Retrieve distinct rows containing: 1) molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), 2) pref_name (from molecule_dictionary), 3) canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), 4) mesh_heading (from drug_indication), 5) efo_term (from drug_indication). Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno to get indication details, and join compound_structures on molregno for the structure. Filter the indication specifically for type 2 diabetes by using: LOWER(mesh_heading) LIKE '%diabetes mellitus, type 2%' OR LOWER(efo_term) LIKE '%type 2 diabetes mellitus%'. Return all matching distinct rows without any row limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%diabetes mellitus, type 2%' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%type 2 diabetes mellitus%')
